mode.description:
Where the transcript comes from. Replaces the legacy source + allow_asr
pair (still supported, but not in the same request as mode). Note that
mode=auto is not legacy source=auto: source=auto alone never uses ASR
(that is mode=captions_only).
  - auto: captions first; speech-to-text (ASR) only when the video has none. Can charge ASR credits.
  - captions_only: any captions (human or YouTube auto-generated), never ASR. When mode is omitted, the account default from the API Dashboard applies (auto for accounts created from October 2026, captions_only for older ones unless changed).
  - human_captions_only: human-made captions only, never ASR.
  - speech_to_text_only: always transcribe the audio with ASR. Charges ASR credits.
On /transcribe, ASR modes return status processing with a job_id to poll
at GET /jobs/{job_id} when no webhook_url is given. Responses echo the
mode the request ran with (for legacy requests, the equivalent mode).
mode.title: Mode

format.description: Which extras to include in the transcript payload.

webhook_url.description: Required when mode is auto or speech_to_text_only (legacy - source="asr" or allow_asr=true)
webhook_url.title: Webhook Url

asr_options.description:
Rich ASR configuration. Only applies when the
video is transcribed via ASR (mode speech_to_text_only or auto fallback; legacy source="asr" or allow_asr). Billable
add-ons increase credit cost proportional to duration - use
/transcribe/estimate to preview.
